title: Shopfi subscription billing contract (BILL-00)
description: Request and response bodies of the billing API: /api/v1/platform/billing/**, /api/v1/admin/billing/**, the signup card step additions of /api/v1/platform/onboarding/*, the Paystack billing webhook and the dev-only billing clock. Every response body is the CustomApiResponse envelope {description, data}. The examples in billing.md are validated against this file. Rules JSON Schema cannot express (state machine, proration, check order, ordering of webhook events) are in billing.md.

Timestamp.description: An instant in UTC, always ending in Z (plans.md section 1).

Pesewas.description: Integer GHS pesewas (GHS 1 = 100), never a float.

PlainText.description: Plain text (plans.md section 1): rejects Cc, Cf, U+2028/2029; clients render it as text.

Reason.description: Free-text reason: plain text, trimmed, 5..500 characters (board BILL-06 AC2).

PaymentReference.description: Billing charge reference: sub-<t|l>-<tenantId>-<kind>-<n>-<attempt> (kind tc|rn|up|sb|mn), or a card verification reference sub-card-<t|l>-<24 lower-case alphanumerics>. Hyphens only (Paystack allows letters, digits, - . =).

CheckoutUrl.description: Paystack hosted checkout URL (authorization_url returned by Paystack). The frontend allow-lists the host.

BillingState.description: The three independent fields (billing.md section 3): subscription lifecycle (+ two flags), payment status, access state.

Card.description: Display data of the default authorization. The authorization code, signature and customer code are never part of any response (S1).

pricePesewas.description: Catalog price of the target at preview time, informational: the renewal charges the price locked at the renewal.

PriceChange.description: Pending price change notice (BR-09). earliestEffectiveAt = notifiedAt + price_change_notice_days; the new price applies at the first renewal on or after it.

BannerParams.description: Only the keys listed for the banner kind in billing.md section 9.3 are present. Banners carry codes and values, never display text.

Actions.description: Server-computed capability flags so the client does not re-implement the state rules. A false flag is advice; the endpoint stays the authority.

BillingBannerView.description: The same endpoint for FRONT_DESK: non-financial banners only (kinds TRIAL_ENDING, PAYMENT_FAILED_GRACE, ACCESS_RESTRICTED; params only trialEndsAt, daysLeft, graceEndsAt).

PaymentView.description: Member view of one charge attempt. No provider ids, no fees, no authorization data. failureCode is a fixed code; raw provider text is never returned (S1, S9).

DocAmounts.description: Credit notes carry NEGATIVE net, tax and total. taxRateBps, taxInclusive and taxLabel are null when no tax line applies.

BusinessIdentity.description: Snapshot at issue. A key whose setting was empty at issue time is ABSENT (never null or an empty string), so no blank labels are rendered.

BillingDocument.description: Immutable document row (BILL-05). INVOICE and RECEIPT are PAID (documents exist only for successful charges), CREDIT_NOTE is CREDITED.

CardVerifyResult.description: retryPayment is the immediate charge attempt started because the subscription was PAST_DUE (BILL-04 AC5), else null.

Proration.description: chargeNet = round_half_up(priceDifference x remainingSeconds / periodSeconds); chargeTax is 0 unless tax_rate_bps is set and tax_inclusive is false; chargeNow = chargeNet + chargeTax.

CardSetup.description: Everything the card step shows, from the server only (BILL-FE-02a AC2).

OnboardingCardStatus.description: data of the verify (202) and status (200) responses when the card step applies to the signup (billing.md section 5). cardSetupToken, cardSetupExpiresAt and cardSetup appear ONLY in the verify response while phase is AWAITING_CARD, never in a status poll.

BillingSettings.description: The platform billing settings (billing_settings, ONE row). Cross-field rules are in billing.md section 4.2.

BillingSettingsRequest.description: PUT body: every setting plus the version read (full replace, optimistic lock).

CredentialStatus.description: Write-only credentials (S2): the keys are never returned, only configured, the last 4 characters of each and metadata. webhookUrl is built from server configuration, never from input.

CredentialsRequest.description: PUT credentials. Prefixes must match the environment of the path (pk_test_/sk_test_ for test, pk_live_/sk_live_ for live).

SettingsAuditRow.description: One row per save. changes[] is field level; credential fields appear as before/after the string "changed" or last4 only, never a key (S2).

facets.description: Counts for the quick filters over the whole filtered-by-environment set, not only the page.

AdminPaymentView.description: Console view of a charge attempt: adds environment, fees, verification, flags and refund arithmetic. refundableRemaining = amount - refunded - pendingRefund (0 unless SUCCESS, not CARD_VERIFY, inside refund_max_days).

SubscriptionActionRequest.description: POST /subscriptions/{slug}/actions. Exactly one shape per action; reason and expectedVersion are always required.

HistoryItem.description: Merged, newest first. summary is a fixed code (for example PAYMENT_SUCCESS, REFUND_COMPLETED, INVOICE_ISSUED, EVENT_<name>), never free text.

BillingAuditRow.description: Append-only. before and after never contain a secret, an authorization code or a webhook body (S1, S2, S6).

WebhookEventRow.description: No payload body is ever returned (S3).

PaystackEvent.description: Inbound Paystack event (the raw request body; the shape is Paystack's, only the fields billing.md section 12 reads are constrained).

Timeseries.description: UTC bucket boundaries (week = Monday 00:00Z), zero-filled gaps (a bucket with no data is 0; CONVERSION with no trials ended is null).

TenantBillingFields.description: The keys BILL-01b adds to every platform tenant summary object (platform-tenants.md). Booleans and enums only; no card data.

ErrorEnvelope.description: Every non-2xx body. branch on the status and, where documented, data.code, never on description. data is null, a field map (400 validation) or an object with code.

CodeErrorEnvelope.description: A body whose data is exactly {code} for the codes that carry no extra keys.
